title: Toasts
line: See extension notices without interrupting your draft.

beats.caption: You check the working tree with `/changes`.
A small card reports that the working tree is clean.
beats.label: pi-toasts

beats.caption: The card clears while your draft stays put.

takeaway.title: Keep your place
takeaway.line: Extension notices clear on their own while you type.

title.text: A quick update from an extension can be useful while you’re getting your next prompt ready.

scene.text: You check for changes in a clean project. The result shows in a card in the top right. Keep typing, and the card disappears while the prompt you started stays where it was.

takeaway.text: When an extension has something brief to tell you, you can read it and carry on from the same place.
